readiness_metadata.note: M26-C implements mock-only dry-run execution. No real platform adapter is operational under the new architecture.

mock_adapter.description: Strict hardware-free MockRobotAdapter with deterministic clock, telemetry, command receipts, and failure injection.

adapter_registry.description: Explicit mock-only registry. No hardware discovery, filesystem scanning, or vendor imports.

skill_service_skeleton.description: Deterministic dry-run SkillService for preflight, command, telemetry, stop, and end-to-end operations.

dry_run_end_to_end.description: Mock-only end-to-end flow covers connect, preflight, locomotion ready, command, telemetry, stop, restore, and audit.

unified_skill_runtime.description: Only a dry-run mock service skeleton exists; no real platform runtime.

prohibited_claims: No K1 migration is complete under the new architecture.
No G1 or GO1 runtime support is implemented.
No hardware verification has been performed.

successor_note.note: M26-C remains the mock service milestone. M26-D adds agent-callable JSON CLI invocation without changing real-platform readiness.
